offering_description.value: Sells advertising space on billboards, transit displays and street furniture to brands and agencies, and builds and operates those displays under leases or contracts with landowners, transit operators and municipalities.

primary_products.value: digital billboards; static billboards; transit displays; street furniture displays; airport displays

primary_services.value: advertising space sales; display installation and maintenance; ad content management

customer_segment.value: B2B: advertisers, brands, media agencies; B2G: municipalities and transit authorities that grant display rights

end_markets.value: retail; consumer goods; automotive; entertainment; financial services

revenue_model.value: advertising: advertisers pay for ad placements on displays

value_chain_position.value: asset operator: owns or leases and runs billboard, transit and street furniture displays, sells ad space to advertisers and agencies

geography_served.value: global: North America, Latin America, Europe and Asia-Pacific markets

specialization.value: niche specialist: outdoor advertising displays only

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: national and local sales teams selling to advertisers; agents / brokers: media agencies and programmatic ad buying platforms

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: local zoning and permits for display structures, traffic safety and advertising content rules

notes: Footprint and country list may have changed through divestitures and ownership changes; country details are approximate.
